aliases: Different components of a competency standard
Parts of a unit of competency
banglaExplanation: Competency standard-এর প্রতিটি unit কয়েকটি নির্দিষ্ট অংশে লেখা থাকে।
Unit code and title নাম দেয়, nominal hours সময় বলে, unit descriptor ছোট summary দেয়।
Elements হলো কাজের মূল activities; performance criteria বলে কোন standard-এ করলে competent ধরা হবে।
Range statement বলে কোন contexts and conditions-এ প্রযোজ্য; evidence guide দেয় assessment-এর guidance।

example.bn: Element হলো কাজ, performance criteria হলো সেই কাজের মাপকাঠি।
example.en: A baking unit has the element 'Produce biscuit dough'. Its performance criteria tell the assessor what standard is competent.

short.modelAnswer:
Each competency standard describes:
1. Unit code and title
2. Nominal hours
3. Unit descriptor
4. Elements of competency
5. Performance criteria
6. Range statement (range of variables)
7. Evidence guide
8. Accreditation requirements

viva.prompt: What does a range statement specify?

realQuestions.label: Final Formative 01 (Short 16)
realQuestions.question: What are the components of a competency standard?

realQuestions.answer:
A range statement may include applicable legislation (such as
OSH), tools, equipment, processes and procedures, special characteristics and
needs of learner groups, location, and the application of work under the quality-
assurance system.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (Short 2)
realQuestions.question: What type of information is included in a range statement?

realQuestions.answer:
A basic task or function within a unit of competency. It describes a
task that can be performed as part of a broader job or role.
realQuestions.label: Short Questions (Short 31)
realQuestions.question: What is an element of competency?

realQuestions.answer:
Performance criteria specify the standard of performance that must
be achieved to be considered competent.

realQuestions.question: Specific benchmarks that measure successful completion of an element.

realQuestions.answer:
An element of competency is a term used in industry competency standards, serving as
the basic building block of a unit of competence. It describes the tasks that contribute to
the broader function or job.

The evidence guide provides guidance to the interpretation and assessment of the unit of
competency. including
• The underpinning knowledge, skills and attitude requirements for the unit
• The aspects which need to be emphasized in assessment,
• Relationships to other units, and
• The required evidence of competency.
